achievements.browsing_public: You are browsing the public catalog.
achievements.fence_body: achievements decorate — they never empower. No gate anywhere consults this page: standing for office needs residency, and nothing else (Art. I · CI-1). And the service that writes it refuses to count: it returns which achievements you hold, never how many (PI-6).
achievements.intro: Your earned records — civic firsts and finished journeys — kept as a list, never a score. Nothing on this page grants anything: no vote, no seat, no role, no eligibility, ever.
achievements.journeys_gloss: Finished journey arcs are self-reported ticks — labeled walkthroughs precisely so they cannot borrow the verified tier\
achievements.jurisdiction_gloss: These celebrate what a place does together — a first election, a seated court, a mutual-aid net. They carry no person\
achievements.jurisdiction_title: Jurisdiction milestones — a place, never a person
achievements.ledger_note: The ledger behind this page can only ever gain an entry — append-only by database trigger, sealed to the audit chain. An achievement is earned once; the one-time training completion bonus that reads it can never pay twice.
achievements.not_earnable: not yet earnable — its surface is still being built
achievements.not_reached_published: not yet reached · published to the public record when it is
achievements.signin_tail: to see your own earned marks — they are yours alone until you choose to show them on your profile.
achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.verified_gloss: Written by the system when the permanent record shows the act — a filing, a seating, a confirmation. Entries about voting read only the sealed envelope that proves you took part; the ballot inside is never opened (Art. II).
